concerns.text: US-2 scenario 2 requires the shallow NN to 'complete within 60 minutes without GPU errors' on the Actions runner. No task measures or asserts this per-model 60-minute constraint — T011 only checks the 6-hour total (SC-005). Add a per-model NN training-time measurement/assertion to T005 or T011.

concerns.text: FR-001 and US-1 scenario 2 require parsing nested JSON (OpenML-style) into the flat schema. T002's actions mention 'any nested JSON structures' but both bundled inputs are CSVs and T002's verification tests only a CSV-derived fixture, so the JSON parsing path has no task deliverable or test. Add a JSON fixture + parser test to T002 (or explicitly document this as part of the FR-001 spec gap).

Plan Phase 9 and the spec edge case 'Missing measured stress for all samples' require setting `proxy_dependent=True` in the final report and omitting mediation. No task implements or tests the proxy_dependent flag (T008 handles the <50 gate; T009 the skip row; T010 the report). Add the zero-measured-stress / proxy_dependent branch to T008 or T010 with a test.

T002's verification requires schema validation 'with jsonschema', but neither plan.md's pinned dependency list nor T001's package check includes `jsonschema`. Add it to T001's verified package list so the dependency is covered by a task.
